title: gymnanthemum bockianum
intro: Gymnanthemum bockianum, commonly known as Bock's tree horehound, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, coughs, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Gymnanthemum bockianum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as being an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
